instruction: Evaluate and selectively integrate these mature free/open-source patterns. Reuse before rebuild. Do not add paid model/API dependencies. Run isolated experiments before promotion. Keep Storybook autonomous and non-blocking when ChatGPT is absent.

findings.name: Storybook Vitest addon
findings.lesson: For Vite-powered Storybook, official Storybook recommends the Vitest addon over the legacy test runner. It transforms stories into real browser tests, supports interaction/accessibility/visual testing, CLI/CI, coverage and watch mode, and does not require a separately running Storybook instance.
findings.candidate_use: Make every generated specimen executable evidence, not just build output. Add autonomous render/interaction/a11y/visual gates and watch-mode feedback.

findings.name: Playwright visual comparisons + tracing
findings.lesson: Playwright provides deterministic screenshot baselines/diffs and DOM/action tracing. Stable environment is required for reliable visual comparison.
findings.candidate_use: Add a local visual-evidence layer: screenshots at fixed desktop/mobile viewports, baseline/diff artifacts, console/network/DOM trace on failures. Do not auto-promote baselines merely because output changed.

findings.name: OpenHands Skills
findings.lesson: OpenHands uses repository-specific and shareable context-triggered skills. Skills encode focused reusable domain knowledge and workflows and activate based on context/triggers.
findings.candidate_use: Evolve Doré skills from failure fixes into design capabilities: editorial-hero, typography, image-field, responsive transformation, visual-regression diagnosis, reference-qualification. Promote only after verified experiments.

findings.name: OpenHands Agent/Runtime separation
findings.lesson: OpenHands separates Agent/AgentController state and decisions from Runtime actions/observations, using an event stream as communication backbone.
findings.candidate_use: Confirms current Thin Runtime + Doré Agent Core direction. Strengthen event/evidence stream instead of moving reasoning back into resident_runtime.

findings.name: LangGraph persistence/checkpoint patterns
findings.lesson: Durable checkpoints support fault tolerance, pending writes, replay/time-travel and memory across interactions. Successful work need not be rerun when another node fails.
findings.candidate_use: Wire the existing SQLite durable_store into actual Agent Core state transitions. Persist goal, hypothesis, specimen, test evidence, rejection reason and next action. Resume from last successful checkpoint after crash/restart.

findings.name: LangGraph interrupts
findings.lesson: External/human input should be a durable interrupt with saved state, not a global stalled runtime. Side effects before interruption must be idempotent.
findings.candidate_use: Model ChatGPT/human requests as durable non-blocking pending interrupts attached to a goal. Other runnable goals/actions continue. Matching response resumes exact checkpoint.

findings.name: mini-swe-agent simplicity
findings.lesson: Modern autonomous coding agents can remain small and effective; avoid adding orchestration complexity without measured benefit.
findings.candidate_use: Do not replace Doré with another framework. Borrow the minimal observe-act loop and environment isolation; keep current architecture small and testable.

findings.name: AutoGen event-driven runtime pattern (reference only)
findings.lesson: AutoGen demonstrates event-driven agent/runtime/message-passing layering but is now in maintenance mode and recommends its successor for new systems.
findings.candidate_use: Use only as architectural evidence for event-driven/non-blocking messaging. Do not adopt AutoGen as a new dependency.

recommended_architecture_delta.priority_1: Close the evidence loop: Story -> real-browser test -> screenshot/trace -> structured observation -> Agent Core decision.
recommended_architecture_delta.priority_2: Make durable_store operational, not decorative: checkpoint every autonomous design iteration and resume after crash/restart.
recommended_architecture_delta.priority_3: Add a design-skill promotion pipeline: candidate lesson -> isolated experiment -> verified skill -> trigger metadata -> reuse metrics.
recommended_architecture_delta.priority_4: Add novelty/information-gain guardrails: reject repeated near-identical specimens and repeated hypotheses before spending another iteration.
recommended_architecture_delta.priority_5: Separate quality gates: BUILD_PASS, FUNCTION_PASS, A11Y_PASS, VISUAL_STABLE, DESIGN_DISTINCT, WESTSIDE_FIT. Build PASS must never equal design PASS.
recommended_architecture_delta.priority_6: Maintain an autonomous runnable-goal queue so pending peer/human work cannot freeze Storybook.
recommended_architecture_delta.priority_7: Track learning effectiveness: same failure recurrence, skill reuse count, autonomous recovery rate, rejected-specimen diversity, human/peer intervention rate. Improvement means intervention declines for repeated problem classes.
recommended_architecture_delta.priority_8: Keep #262 locked as read-only visual reference/control, not an automatically updated screenshot baseline.

acceptance_experiment.name: storybook-autonomy-evidence-loop-v1
steps: Generate or modify one non-production Storybook specimen from a selected reference pattern.
Capture fixed desktop and mobile visual evidence with Playwright-compatible tooling.
If rejected, persist the rejection reason and select a materially different next hypothesis without ChatGPT input.
Run at least three autonomous iterations across a restart boundary and prove checkpoint resume.
Promote a reusable design skill only if its experiment passes; record reuse trigger and provenance.
Return telemetry showing forward progress while any ChatGPT peer request remains pending/non-blocking.
